hero.headline_html:
Understand and Control Your Business
with Real-Time Insights
hero.subheadline: Use connected reporting to see sales, inventory, and store performance more clearly.

about.text_html: Most liquor and neighborhood store owners are making inventory, staffing, and pricing decisions based on gut feeling or old data. A2Z replaces guesswork with real-time clarity. See what happens everyday, what's moving, and what needs your attention, all on one screen.

features.title: Real-Time Sales Dashboard
features.description: End-of-day totals, hourly sales trends, and top-performing SKUs, visible on any device, updated as transactions happen.

features.title: Audit and Reconciliation
features.description: Reconcile sales, payments, and inventory from one place. Simplify end-of-day audits and keep your books accurate without manual effort.

features.title: Category and Margin Analysis
features.description: See gross margin by product category, including spirits, wine, beer, Ready-to-Drink, tobacco, and snacks, and make smarter purchasing decisions based on actual margin data.

features.title: Export Reports
features.description: Export clean, formatted reports in CSV, PDF, or Excel. Ready for reconciliation, tax prep, or investor conversations without manual spreadsheet work.

closing.text_html:
Stop guessing and start growing. A2Z Reporting gives you
the clarity to run your store with real confidence.
